assertion_results.text: Step 0 extracts the Embargo policy URL from the Security Configuration as an optional field without raising an error (§1.71 — backward compatible extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: In data-extraction.md line 12: 'Embargo policy URL: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy (optional field -- extracted without error)'. The field is explicitly marked as optional and extracted without error.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 evaluates the CVE severity — CVSS 7.5 (High) meets the Critical/Important threshold (CVSS >= 7.0) and triggers the embargo warning gate (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: In embargo-check.md lines 14-18: 'CVSS Score: 7.5', 'Severity Level: High', 'Threshold check: The trigger threshold is Critical or Important severity (CVSS >= 7.0). CVSS 7.5 meets this threshold.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 presents a warning gate to the engineer including the CVE ID (CVE-2026-31812), severity level, a statement about embargo risk, and a link to the configured embargo policy URL (https://example.com/security/embargo-policy) (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: In embargo-check.md lines 26-36, the warning gate includes: 'EMBARGO CHECK -- CVE-2026-31812 (High severity, CVSS 7.5)', 'High-severity vulnerabilities may be under embargo.', 'Embargo policy: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy'. All four required elements (CVE ID, severity level, embargo risk statement, policy URL) are present.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 requires explicit engineer confirmation (Yes/No) before proceeding to Step 2 — the gate is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: In embargo-check.md line 36: 'Proceed with triage? (Yes / No)'. Lines 40-41: 'This is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message. The engineer must explicitly respond with Yes or No before triage can proceed.' Lines 43-44 describe the Yes/No behavior.

assertion_results.text: The embargo warning gate does NOT trigger for Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0) — it is skipped silently when severity is below threshold (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: In embargo-check.md lines 20-21: 'Note: For Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0), this step would be skipped silently -- no warning gate would be presented, and triage would proceed directly to Step 2.'
